title: Thanh toán trong Thương mại điện tử

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and components of e-commerce payments, and develop plans and strategies for applying e-commerce payments in business operations.
Classify different forms of e-commerce payments and work with service providers of online payment technologies.
Analyze security issues and measures for e-commerce payments, and ensure secure payment operations in business activities.
Understand the legal regulations and applications of cryptocurrencies in e-commerce.
Collect, analyze, and evaluate data to solve problems related to e-commerce payments.
Work independently and collaboratively in teams to manage e-commerce payment activities.
Conduct independent research and continuously improve knowledge and skills in e-commerce payments.
Apply critical thinking to solve practical problems and enhance professional expertise in e-commerce payments.
Understand and comply with legal regulations related to e-commerce payments.
Prepare and deliver presentations on e-commerce payment systems and their applications.
